oracle_checks.assertion: user_cross_aud_clientA_http_status == 200 AND user_cross_aud_clientA_active == true AND "client_i5_A" in user_cross_aud_clientA_audience
oracle_checks.violation_description: Control token for client-A did not introspect as active/audience-bound; cannot interpret cross-client exchange.
Client-B accepted token exchange using a subject_token minted for client-A and produced a token for audience client-B, violating authorization binding.
